title: evaluation_result/v1
description: Canonical wire-contract schema for the claude CLI --json-schema flag when invoking the agent-retrospective evaluator Agent. Mirrors run_retrospective.py's Evaluation dataclass (WIRE_SCHEMA_EVALUATION = "evaluation_result/v1", Issue #2301). candidate_records[] entries must each independently satisfy the canonical agent_improvement_candidate/v1 schema (#2288/#2289) -- this schema intentionally does not re-embed that full contract inline and only requires candidate_records to be an array of objects at the wire-contract layer; the stricter per-record validation is enforced by run_retrospective.py's _validate_candidate_records() after structured_output parsing.
